summary:
Since the 1960s, NASA has deployed groundbreaking hardware across the Moon, Mars, and deep space from Apollo lunar instruments and Martian rovers to the interstellar Voyager probes. Cosmic Relics is an interactive web platform and gamified storytelling experience designed to introduce school-age space enthusiasts to this legacy equipment and the science it unlocked.

Users explore an interactive 3D solar system map to click on real NASA hardware, inspect authentic mission telemetry, compare operational vs. retired statuses, and complete "Junior Mission Specialist" challenges. By translating complex orbital mechanics, spectrometry, and robotics data into visual stories and interactive simulations, our project bridges the gap between historical archival data and young learners. Understanding where this hardware sits today and what it discovered inspires the next generation of aerospace engineers and planetary scientists while honoring humanity’s greatest off world achievements.
details:
1. What it does & How it works: Cosmic Relics features an interactive Solar System explorer divided into three zones: Lunar Surface (Apollo ALSEP, LRO), Martian Surface (Sojourner, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity, Perseverance, InSight), and Deep Space (Voyager 1 & 2, New Horizons, Cassini). Selecting any piece of hardware opens a mission profile with 3D model inspection, "What It Found" science cards, current operational status, and a mini-quiz.

2. Benefits & Intended Impact: Makes dense NASA archival data accessible, engaging, and age-appropriate for K–12 students. Encourages STEM curiosity by showing how engineering hardware directly answers scientific questions.

3. Tools, Languages & Software Used: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (React / Three.js for 3D visualization), NASA Open Data APIs, and GitHub for version control.

4. Creativity & Design Considerations: Designed with a kid-friendly "Mission Control" interface, high-contrast visual cards, clear operational status indicators (Active vs. Mission Complete), and zero-jargon science explanations tailored for young readers.
